note: Time-boxed healing sessions on the teacher's generated answers (heal_sessions.py; data from heal_shards.py, heal_shards_rules.json). Written 2026-11-05, before any session. The goal (the user, 2026-11-04): improve the student's quality even where it does not match the 9B, and beat dense models with as many parameters as its active ones; the sampler handles the remaining loops.

select.rule: Correct (or ungraded chat) and finished answers; within a problem and thinking mode, answers under 1/3 or over 2 times the median length are dropped, the others kept with probability min(1, median/length). Tokens outside the student's 64K vocabulary become its pieces (heal_sessions.StudentTokens).

train.schedule: Warmup over the first 5 steps of all sessions, then constant; heal_sessions.py decay makes a decayed evaluation copy without touching the main state.

evaluation: After each few sessions, a decayed copy is checked sampled (the card's sampler) on the 96 GSM8K check prompts with thinking on and off, against S0_K24_T3M (on 57, off 51) and the dense yardsticks (Qwen3.5-2B off 71, 4B and 9B off 83); a MATH-500 subset and a non-math check are to be added before the first comparison is claimed.

sessions.name: local 1
sessions.written: 2026-11-05, before the session, while shard 0's later chunks are still generating (its first chunk: 400 problems, 927 answers selected, 91 steps of 4 x 4,096 tokens).
sessions.plan: 3 hours on the local GPU (about 80 steps, about 1M answer tokens), then an 8-step decayed copy, checked sampled on the 96 GSM8K prompts with thinking off and on.

predictions.thinking_off: S0_K24_T3M sampled 51/96 -> 56 to 68 (answers in this mode are the most direct teacher data and the shortest)
predictions.loops: sampled loops stay at 3 or fewer per mode

outcome.written: 2026-11-05, after the session, the decay and the checks.
outcome.session: 81 steps in 3 hours (126 tokens/s), cursor [0, 815] of shard 0's first chunk; logged KL at 10-step points 0.33 to 1.07 with no trend. Decay: 8 steps to decayed_89.pt.
outcome.eval_kl: The corpus eval KL rose from S0_K24_T3M's 0.603 to 0.785 (in-mix 0.571 -> 0.756, held-out 0.732 -> 0.904), in every domain, math_word 0.242 -> 0.363.
outcome.thinking_on: 35/96 right, 55 finished, 1 loop (S0_K24_T3M: 57, 63, 1). The wrong finished answers are well formed but miscalculate (19.50 / 0.75 = 13; 3 x 16.50 = 54.15).
outcome.thinking_off: No result: the check crashed in sampling with a device-side assert (torch's async assert kernel; likely non-finite probabilities from the copy) after the eval KL (0.783).

predictions.thinking_on: failed: 35, below 55 to 66 and below the start's 57

outcome.reading: The session damaged the student. The routers moved most: their total norm went from 16.7 to 31.7 (layers 14-17 changed by 3.8 to 4.5 times their norm) while the LoRA moved 18% (12.7 on 70.7). T3M ended at lr_floor 0.1 (LoRA 1e-5, routers 1e-4); the session restarted both at the peak (1e-4, 1e-3) with fresh Adam state and kept it constant, and the router loss rose from 4.51 to 4.62 over the session. The attribution confirms the routers did most of the damage.
outcome.attribution: Eval KL with parts swapped (attribute_89.log; stopped after two of four arms to free the GPU for another session's benchmark): T3M LoRA and routers 0.603 (reproduces); the session's LoRA with T3M's routers 0.645 (math_word 0.277); both of the session's 0.785. So the LoRA accounts for about 0.04 of the 0.18 rise and the routers for most of the rest.
outcome.amended_2026_11_07: Both checks of decayed_89 ran in processes whose dense pass computed wrong values (check_89_on 16 of 116 eval docs, check_89_off 3; heal_sessions_g2_rules.json machine_faults). The 35/96 and the eval KL 0.785 are not reliable; the router drift (norm 16.7 -> 31.7) and the attribution's lora-only 0.645 (a separate, clean-looking process) stand.
